headline: Friday: NBA Cup night (Knicks @ Pacers, Warriors @ Spurs) and a big college basketball slate.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Thursday this tab went 0-1 (Suns). Today: Lineups picks the Pacers, and Dimers' model projects the Knicks by only 2.

straight.reasoning: Two sources point the same way. Lineups takes Indiana: the Pacers have covered in four straight home games against New York and are 6-0 as home underdogs against the East. Dimers' model projects Knicks 117-115, a 2-point game against a 7.5-point line. Haliburton is still out, which is why the number is this big. Playable to +7; skip at +6.5.

sections.label: NBA
sections.slate: NBA Cup group games tonight, including Knicks @ Pacers (4:00 PM PT) and Warriors @ Spurs (6:30 PM PT). Stephen Curry is expected to miss Golden State's game.

straight.reasoning: Lineups picks Indiana and Dimers projects a 2-point Knicks win. Playable to +7.

Lineups takes Golden State (it has covered the last three in San Antonio), and Dimers projects Spurs by 11. But the Spurs have won 10 straight and Curry is likely out, so it stays a quarter unit. Playable to +12; skip at +11.5.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: Big Friday of college basketball: Virginia @ Maryland, Arizona @ Auburn, Ohio State @ UConn. Each pick comes from one source, so they're quarter units.

straight.reasoning: RotoWire: Virginia is top-15 in offense and defense and beat Arkansas by 19, while Maryland trailed Georgetown by 16 at halftime and is shooting 20.8% from three. The line has moved from -5.5 to -6.5, so look for -6 at some books. Playable to -6.5; skip at -7.

RotoWire likes Auburn at home: Arizona's backcourt is a question after losing to UCLA, and KenPom projects Auburn to win 80-78. Auburn opened as a 1.5-point favorite and is now getting 3, which is a better price than RotoWire's +2.5.
Dimers' model gives Pitt a 58.4% chance to cover, a 6% edge. Playable to +3.
